body:
It looks like zed arguments don't work correctly, if zed is already open it doesn't move to the given line and column.
And if I use the path to `Zed.exe` instead of `zed`, then it only switches focus to zed and doesn't even open the given file.

I don't think we can do anything about it here, though.
It looks like the args you are passing are correct, so it looks good to me.
